base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: the same cosy circular copper kitchen-laboratory, now crowded and cheerful, the mirror-polished table laid for dinner, squirrels perched on shelves and in Marvel's hat. Lighting: warm golden lamplight, the lighthouse beam sweeping past the windows.
In the shot: Tomkin, an anthropomorphic tabby cat who walks upright, slim and wiry, with burnt-orange "artisanal copper" fur and darker copper tiger stripes, bright emerald-green eyes, long expressive whiskers, a smug confident half-smile, brass welding goggles pushed up on his forehead, and a leather tool belt full of tiny gadgets; Ben Elf, a tiny elf about the height of a teacup, neat and bright-eyed, wearing a pointed green hat, a green jacket with eleven unnecessary pockets, and a belt hung with a small brass horn, a spare horn, a scroll, a magnifying glass, a bag of mixed nuts and a laminated official ID card; Gary, a tiny cartoon housefly with big shiny compound eyes, smug self-satisfied angled wings, pulling a minuscule wheeled suitcase; a beautifully plated grilled sea bass fillet beside a perfect scoop of pale-green mint-choc-chip ice cream on a gleaming plate.
Camera: Close on the bowls, then a long pull-back out of the window.
Action: Tomkin gets out more bowls and portions the ice cream with scientific precision — his own share clearly the largest — and sets a tiny thimble by the wall socket for Gary. Ben blows his horn.
Dialogue: Tomkin (crisp, rapid-fire, precise male tenor with a clipped British accent; superior, exasperated, always certain he is the only rational being in the room, grumbling) says: "If anyone tells anyone, I'll recalibrate the Stink-o-Meter." Ben Elf (high-pitched, chipper, officious little male voice, delighted by everything, speaking in excited exclamations, thrilled) says: "'The cat shared his ice cream!' ELF GENEROSITY ALERT!"
Sound effects: scoops, bowl clinks, horn toot, waves, gentle beacon hum, ambience of cosy crackle, distant waves, contented chatter.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
